model.name: appTheme
model.label: App theme
model.description: Bind to {{ theme }} to follow the app's colors and light/dark mode.

model.name: columns
model.label: Columns
model.description: JSON array of column definitions. Each item: { key, label, type (text|number|date|boolean|badge|currency), format?, align? (left|center|right), width?, colors? }. Use the ⚙ editor (showEditors: true) for a visual editor.

model.name: iconConfig
model.label: Icon config
model.description: JSON object mapping file extensions to icon names. Available icons: folder, folder-open, file, file-pdf, file-text, file-code, file-image, file-audio, file-video, file-archive, file-data, file-spreadsheet. Special keys: "folder", "folder-open", "default". Use the 🎨 editor (showEditors: true) for a visual editor.

model.name: selectedPath
model.label: Selected path
model.description: Tree path of the selected node (e.g. project/src/index.tsx).

model.name: selectedFileUrl
model.label: Selected file URL
model.description: The url property of the selected file node — physical path or link (NAS, Google Drive, Retool Files…). Set url on each file node in treeData.

model.name: selectedNode
model.label: Selected node
model.description: JSON du nœud sélectionné. Dans Retool : JSON.parse(filetree1.selectedNode).name

model.name: fontFamily
model.label: Font (rows)
model.description: Font family for row values. Leave empty to inherit the project font.

model.name: headerFontFamily
model.label: Font (headers)
model.description: Font family for column headers. Leave empty to inherit the project font.

model.name: bgColor
model.label: Background color
model.description: Component background color (CSS value, e.g. #fff or transparent).

model.name: selectedBgColor
model.label: Selected row color
model.description: Background color of the selected row.

model.name: hoverBgColor
model.label: Hover row color
model.description: Background color of the hovered row.

model.name: textColor
model.label: Text color (rows)
model.description: Row text color. Leave empty to auto-detect from background (dark text on light bg, light text on dark bg).

model.name: selectedTextColor
model.label: Text color (selected)
model.description: Text color for the selected row. Leave empty to auto-detect from selected row background.

model.name: hoverTextColor
model.label: Text color (hover)
model.description: Text color for hovered rows. Leave empty to auto-detect from hover background.

model.name: headerBgColor
model.label: Header background
model.description: Background color of the column header row.

model.name: headerTextColor
model.label: Header text color
model.description: Text color of column headers. Leave empty to auto-detect from header background.

model.name: nameColumnLabel
model.label: Name column label
model.description: Label for the first (name) column header.

model.name: showEditors
model.label: Show editors
model.description: Enable the ⚙ Columns and 🎨 Icons visual editors directly on the component.

model.name: showDesktopOffice
model.label: Allow Office desktop apps
model.description: Prefer Office desktop opening directly from the row/arrow; users can choose Browser in the tree. File-select handlers should skip files with openHandled=true. Requires Office installed and browser permission. PDFs and folders keep browser links.

model.name: badgeBorderRadius
model.label: Badge border radius
model.description: Border radius (px) for badge cells.

model.name: fields
model.description: Field configuration keyed by data key: label, type, options, group, hidden, readOnly, required, pairedField.

model.name: statusClearRules
model.description: Optional status clearing overrides: {canClear: boolean, reason?: string}. All five statuses allow clearing when related dates and amounts are cleared; zero amounts do not block clearing.

model.name: saveResult
model.description: Bind to temporary state. Handler sets {requestId, success, error}. A matching success acknowledgment marks the submitted changes saved.

model.name: recordId
model.description: Bind to the selected record ID. Unsaved drafts are cached per record while this component remains mounted.

model.name: saveWhileFocused
model.description: Save after a typing pause even if the field stays focused. Turn off to wait until the field loses focus.

model.name: debounceMs
model.description: Autosave delay in milliseconds for dropdown changes.

model.name: typingDebounceMs
model.description: Idle delay after typing, or after leaving a field. New edits are cached while an earlier request saves.

model.name: value
model.description: Plain-text draft. Bind existing posting queries to this value.

model.name: contextId
model.description: Project ID for updates, or parent update ID for replies. Changing it clears the draft.

model.name: resetKey

model.name: placeholder

model.name: appTheme
model.label: App theme

model.name: users
model.description: All permitted mention users: {{ formatDataAsArray(qMentionUsers.data ?? {}) }}

model.name: updates
model.description: Root updates and any inline replies from qProjectUpdates.

model.name: replies
model.description: Reply rows from qProjectReplies. Duplicate IDs are merged.

model.name: attachments
model.description: Required for saved file links: {{ formatDataAsArray(qProjectUpdateFiles.data ?? {}) }}. Include update_id, file_name and sharepoint_web_url; optional thumbnail_url for previews.

model.name: project
model.description: Bind to {{ selectedProjectRow.value ?? {} }}. Captured in every submission.

model.name: postResult
model.description: Required: bind to {{ updatesPostResult.value }} or {{ postProjectUpdate.data ?? {} }}. The matching {requestId, success} acknowledgment ends Posting.

model.name: loading
model.description: Read query loading state; post locking is automatic until postResult acknowledges the request.

model.name: maxAttachmentMB
model.description: Total raw attachment size per post. Base64 adds about one-third. Match your upload query limits.
